subject: Renewal: Dedicated capacity expansion + isolated reserved pool & throughput guarantee
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@borealis.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation — capacity increase questions

Hi Karthik,

We're coming up on our renewal and we'd like to talk about expanding our Dedicated footprint. Over the last quarter we've run into saturation on peak inference windows and would like to discuss adding dedicated GPUs and a reserved pool that is isolated from multi-tenant traffic.

Primary asks:
- Add capacity sufficient for ~8 additional A100-like GPUs (we use a throughput benchmark, not only GPU count).
- Reserved pool isolation: we need guarantees that no other tenant can preempt or co-locate on the same pool (hardware level or strict scheduling isolation).
- Throughput & latency SLOs during peak (expected 8–10k QPS for short windows).

Can you outline how this would look in the renewal (term, pricing, lead time)? Also include any technical documentation we should share with infra.

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of ML Platform, Borealis AI

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@borealis.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — capacity increase questions

Sarah —

Thanks for the note and context. We can absolutely support an expansion at renewal that includes an isolated reserved pool and explicit throughput commitments. High level we recommend the following starting point (can refine after a brief tech sync):

Proposal (initial):
- Add 8 x A100-class GPUs into a new Reserved Pool (dedicated, customer-only).
- Pool isolation: physical cohorting + scheduler pinning so your instances never share host-level GPUs with other customers.
- Baseline throughput SLA: 99.5% availability for target sustained throughput up to 3,000 tokens/sec (burst handling via short-term burst credit).
- Term: 12-month renewal with a committed monthly throughput tier; option to convert to annual reserved commit for deeper discounts.
- Lead time: 3–5 weeks to provision and validate (shorter if we reuse existing cluster topology).

I've looped in Ava (solutions engineering) to confirm the isolation approach and to attach an architecture diagram. Once we align on sizing and SLA we can push an SOW and a DocuSign link for signature.

Would you be available for a 30-min tech + procurement sync on Friday 13th?

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@borealis.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved pool isolation & throughput notes

Hi Sarah —

Quick technical summary so you have something to share with infra/security: please find the attached diagram (reserved_pool_isolation_diagram.png) and the SOW stub in the attachments. Key points:

- Isolation model: we offer two complementary guarantees: (1) physical cohorting (nodes in pool are provisioned from a customer-only host group) and (2) runtime enforcement (scheduler pins your workloads and prevents reallocation). This combination prevents noisy-neighbor interference.
- Data plane: inference requests route through a private ingress for your tenant; KV cache and prefix caching are scoped to the pool. No tenant keys are shared.
- Audit & evidence: we can produce an isolation report and a one-time audit snapshot (host assignment, tenant mapping) for your compliance review.
- Throughput validation: we will run customer-specific load tests during provisioning to validate the 3k tokens/sec steady state and configurable burst policy. If you need higher base throughput (e.g., sustained 5k), tell us now so we can size GPUs and batching accordingly.
- Ops playbook: automated failover to an adjacent reserved pool with warm standby, plus a fallback public pool with lower priority in extreme scale events (will only be used if explicitly enabled).

If you confirm the 8x A100 baseline we will size the pool (GPU memory/instance types) and provide an updated SOW with exact pricing.

— Ava
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@borealis.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved pool isolation & throughput notes

Thanks, Ava and Karthik — this looks good. A few clarifications from our infra/security team:

- Confirmation that host-level cohorting is by-tenant (not just soft tagging) and that you can provide a host assignment snapshot post-provisioning.
- We want the option of an additional 4 GPU warm standby capacity that is reserved for our pool (not shared) to absorb short-term spikes.
- Pricing: can you show monthly commit vs. annual pricing? We'll be presenting both options for budget planning.

If you can get the SOW and the pricing options by Monday 16th we can route internally and get back quickly.

Sarah
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@borealis.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Dedicated capacity expansion + isolated reserved pool & throughput guarantee

Sarah —

Thanks for the clarifications. Summary of what we've agreed and next steps (SOW attached):

1) Capacity & isolation
- Primary reserved pool: 8 x A100-class GPUs (customer-only cohort).
- Warm standby: 4 x A100-class GPUs reserved and billed at the committed standby rate; will be attached to the pool for bursts or failover.
- Host assignment snapshots: we will deliver a one-time provisioning snapshot and a quarterly isolation report (CSV + orchestration logs) for audit.

2) SLA & throughput
- Baseline throughput guarantee: validated 3,000 tokens/sec sustained with a short-term burst policy up to 5,500 tokens/sec, 99.5% uptime for provisioned throughput.

3) Commercials & contracting
- Term: 12 months by default; annual prepay option available for a 12% discount.
- Pricing options: included in the attached SOW (Redwood_Dedicated_SOW_v4.pdf) — both monthly commit and annual prepay columns.
- Deal id: DEAL-2026-031-BOR.

4) Next steps
- I attached the SOW and reserved pool diagram. If this looks good I'll route a DocuSign (link below) for signature and schedule a provisioning kickoff (estimated 3 weeks from signature).
- DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/ABC-DocuSign-Link
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-2026-031-BOR

Please reply with confirmation (or any final redlines) and we will start contract routing.

Best,
Karthik
